items: Extract Keywords: Copy the entire job posting into a document and highlight every hard requirement using the exact phrasing from the posting.
Extract Keywords: Identify every soft preference phrase in the job posting by looking for words like 'preferred,' 'ideal,' or 'nice to have.'
Extract Keywords: Research 3-5 LinkedIn profiles of people currently working in your target role at similar companies to find industry shorthand not in the posting.
Extract Keywords: Build a master keyword list combining all three layers of language with every term appearing somewhere in your resume.
Quantify Your Data: Replace vague descriptions like 'led a team that improved customer satisfaction' with specific numbers and measurable outcomes.
Quantify Your Data: Add specific metrics to accomplishments by including percentages, dollar amounts, timeframes, and team sizes.
Quantify Your Data: Use ATS-friendly formatting by placing numbers and data points in plain text rather than embedded in graphics or tables.
Quantify Your Data: Frame soft skills with hard evidence by following claims like 'project management' with concrete examples of project scope.
Structure for Parsing: Use standard section headers like 'Work Experience' and 'Education' instead of creative titles that ATS systems cannot categorize.
Structure for Parsing: Place the most important keywords in the top third of your resume where ATS systems weight them most heavily.
Structure for Parsing: Submit your resume in plain text or .docx format to ensure the ATS parser can extract your content accurately.
Structure for Parsing: Avoid headers, footers, columns, and text boxes that ATS systems cannot parse correctly.
